contentBlocks.description: Active NSFAS recipients are generally excluded from SASSA grants, but there are exceptions. Learn the rules, what documentation you need if your NSFAS has ended, and how to appeal if your status is incorrect.

contentBlocks.text: SASSA Grant Eligibility for NSFAS-Funded Students

NSFAS-funded students are generally not eligible for SRD R370 or other social grants, because NSFAS already covers living allowances. However, if your NSFAS funding has been cancelled or completed, you may qualify. Understanding the rules — and what documentation you need — can save you months of frustration.

SASSA and NSFAS serve different purposes. NSFAS covers education costs (tuition, accommodation, transport, and living allowances), while SASSA grants address basic living expenses. The government's position is that NSFAS-funded students should not receive both because their education-related living costs are already subsidised. However, former NSFAS recipients may qualify for SASSA after their studies end.

Sipho graduated from the University of Cape Town in December 2025 with a degree funded by NSFAS. After graduating, he applied for the SRD R370 grant but was declined because SASSA's database still showed him as 'NSFAS Funded'. Sipho requested a NSFAS completion letter from the myNSFAS portal, filed an appeal on the ITSAA portal, and was approved 3 months later. This guide explains exactly what Sipho — and any former NSFAS student — needs to do to prove their funding has ended.

steps.title: Confirm your NSFAS status
steps.description: Log into the myNSFAS portal at www.nsfas.org.za and check your current funding status. Take a screenshot.

steps.title: Get proof of non-funding
steps.description: If your funding has ended, request a NSFAS cancellation or completion letter from the myNSFAS portal. This can take 5-10 business days.

steps.title: Wait for database update
steps.description: NSFAS sends updates to SASSA's database periodically. If your status still shows active after 2 weeks, you will need to appeal.

steps.title: Apply for SRD R370
steps.description: Go to srd.sassa.gov.za and apply. Attach your NSFAS letter if the system allows.

steps.title: Appeal if incorrectly declined
steps.description: If SASSA declines you saying you are NSFAS-funded, appeal on the ITSAA portal and upload your NSFAS cancellation/completion letter.

contentBlocks.title: Important
contentBlocks.text: You cannot receive NSFAS and a SASSA grant in the same month — even if your NSFAS allowance is delayed or you are not actively studying. If you are registered for the academic year, you are excluded for the full year, including vacation months.

items: Applying for SASSA while still registered as an active NSFAS student — your application will be automatically declined
Waiting too long to get your NSFAS cancellation letter — request it immediately after your studies end or your funding is cancelled
Not appealing a 'NSFAS Funded' decline — this is a database error that can be fixed with the right documentation
Assuming vacation months are treated as 'not funded' — you are excluded for the full academic year

faqs.question: I finished my degree but SASSA says I am still funded by NSFAS. Why?
faqs.answer: NSFAS databases are not always updated immediately. Upload your graduation certificate or academic transcript along with a NSFAS completion letter to trigger the database update. Then appeal the decline.

faqs.question: Can I get a SASSA grant during my NSFAS-funded vacation?
faqs.answer: No. If you are registered as an active NSFAS student, you are excluded from SASSA grants for the full academic year, including vacation months.

faqs.question: Do I need to appeal every month if NSFAS is still showing?
faqs.answer: Yes. You must appeal for each declined month individually. However, once you submit proof of non-funding, subsequent months should be approved automatically.

faqs.question: How long does it take for NSFAS to update the SASSA database?
faqs.answer: NSFAS sends batch updates to SASSA periodically. It can take 2-6 weeks for your status to be updated. If it takes longer, file an appeal with your supporting documents.

faqs.question: Can I get the Child Support Grant if I am a NSFAS-funded student with a child?
faqs.answer: Yes. The Child Support Grant is for the child, not the student. Being NSFAS-funded does not disqualify you from receiving the Child Support Grant as a parent.
